name: Blender 3D Scene Creator
description: Autonomously creates, sets up, and renders 3D scenes in Blender 4.4 with procedural objects, lighting, materials, and cameras using bpy Python automation.

tools.name: blender_create_scene
tools.description: Create a complete 3D scene in Blender with objects, lighting, camera, and materials. Saves to a .blend file and optionally opens Blender GUI.

description.description: Detailed description of objects, layout, and colors

output_blend_path.description: Optional file path to save the .blend scene

open_gui.description: Whether to launch Blender GUI with the scene open (default true)

tools.name: blender_render
tools.description: Render a 3D scene from Blender to a high-resolution PNG image.

blend_file.description: Path to the .blend file (optional, uses active scene if omitted)

output_image_path.description: Target PNG file path for the render

tools.name: blender_run_python
tools.description: Execute arbitrary bpy Python script in Blender for advanced modeling, shading, and animation.
